notes.title: Jolly's Park Chapter 1 - Major Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey guys! I'm here announcing a big update for Jolly's Park Chapter 1!

This update will countain a lot of news, including remodels, new animations, better scenarios, localization, lore stuff, and a lot of more content!

We are planning to release this update from the end of this year to january, 2025.
Chapter 2 will probably release in october or november in the next year.
That's it!

notes.title: JOLLY'S PARK - UPDATE 1.0.1 PART 1
notes.notes:
Hey guys! In part 1 of 1.0.1 we fixed the main glitches and improved optimization, also we changed some meshes!


 Fixed the ventilation glitch, where you could uncrouch and fly away by the map.



 Changed the final Wally chase model.


Improved optimization, removing some post processing effects:


 Global Illumination
 Temperature Color
 Motion Blur
 Depth of Field


WHAT IS COMING ON PART 2?


 Localization (Portuguese, Spanish, German, etc..)
 Cutscenes (Chases, fights.)
 Improved animations (Removing generic animations.)
